capabilities.name: share-account
capabilities.description: Normalise a share-account aggregate readback into the port's vocabulary: map the account status and purchase status stored ids to their stored values, and transcribe the purchased price and purchased amount DECIMAL money into 2 minor units. The purchase total is requestedShares * unitPrice = 100 * 100 = 10000.00, an integer-times-integer minor-unit product with NO rounding surface.
capabilities.evidence: Capture share-account-detail-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle stored account id 3 (status 300 Active, totalApprovedShares 100) with purchasedShares[0] numberOfShares 100, purchasedPrice 100.00, amount 10000.00, purchase status 300 Approved.

capabilities.name: share-dividend
capabilities.description: Normalise a share-product dividend's dividendAmount field into integer minor units. The capture records the amount the oracle STORED (0.010000), which is the HALF_UP-rounded read-back of the 0.005 request; the rounding itself is a later slice and is NOT graded, so the port only normalises the stored read-back to one minor unit.
capabilities.evidence: Capture shares-product-dividends-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle stored dividend id 3 with amount 0.010000, the HALF_UP read-back of the discriminating 0.005 dividendAmount request (HALF_UP 0.01 / HALF_EVEN 0.00, verdict HALF_UP).

seams.name: share-account
seams.description: GET /accounts/share/{accountId} on the running Fineract server (Path B), tenant gerege, read back as the share-account aggregate (status, summary, purchasedShares).

seams.name: share-dividend
seams.description: GET /shareproduct/{productId}/dividend (and the share-account aggregate's dividends list) on the running Fineract server (Path B), tenant gerege, read back as the share-product dividend row.

note: Shares parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Two capabilities are graded: the share-account aggregate normalisation (share-account seam) and the share-product dividend amount normalisation (share-dividend seam). The dividend create command's HALF_UP rounding (0.005 -> 0.01) is NOT in the graded domain: the shares slice's command plumbing is not yet ported, and the port's exact-money parser (MinorUnitsFromDecimalText) refuses sub-minor-unit residue rather than reproducing the oracle's Money.setScale(2, HALF_UP). The dividend vector therefore transcribes the STORED read-back (0.010000 -> 1 minor unit), not the rounding.
